items.claim: Marketplace 加速成長被歸因於多年投資同時見效，而非單一改變。
items.quote: there's no one particular thing that we changed.
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 賣家庫存放在 WFS 的商品轉換率比一般高 50%。
items.quote: that converts at 50% higher conversion rate overall
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 以 Nespresso 為例，新品類帶來沒買過咖啡的新客。
items.quote: never bought coffee from us before
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 管理層表示高所得家庭對新品類的滲透率偏高。
items.quote: We're seeing high penetration of higher-income households
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 管理層形容 Marketplace 仍處早期階段，品類仍有缺口待補。
items.quote: it's first inning right now
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 品類組合仍有缺口，正在補齊品牌與賣家。
items.quote: we still have gaps in assortment
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 已開放加拿大與墨西哥消費者購買美國賣家的商品。
items.quote: We open up dot-com for Canadians and Mexicans
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 賣家可借用既有供應鏈，沃爾瑪稱不需大額新增投資。
items.quote: to our sellers without significant investment
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 管理層稱 4,500 家門市加品類是與他人的差異點。
items.quote: nobody can replicate the 4,500 stores
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: Marketplace 以一般商品為主，食品占比低。
items.quote: marketplace is predominantly general merchandise
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 針對同店可比銷售，管理層表示正研究補充性指標。
items.quote: we are working on how do we provide complementary metrics
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: Marketplace 以淨銷售額申報，GMV 是內部另看的指標。
items.quote: we report on net sales, [ GMV ] is another metric
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 電商取貨與配送上季成長 43%。
items.quote: e-commerce, online pickup delivery grew 43% last quarter
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 門市被描述為履約節點，並給出配送覆蓋範圍。
items.quote: 95% of America is in 3 hours delivery range of stores
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 開始依資料把第三方庫存前置到門市後倉。
items.quote: forward deploying inventory into the stores in the back
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 目前前置庫存只放在後倉，尚未上貨架。
items.quote: we're starting with the backroom to place inventory there
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 引述 CFO 說法，Marketplace 是第二損益表成長的關鍵。
items.quote: marketplace is a lynchpin for our second P&L growth
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 賣家使用 WFS 成本低 15%。
items.quote: A seller sees 15% lower cost when it's in WFS.
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: WFS 加廣告的商品，GMV 有時成長 5 倍。
items.quote: we see sometimes 5x GMV growth
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 管理層提到也在評估 Data Ventures 作為賣家新服務。
items.quote: We are also looking at Data Ventures.
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 測試降費時，賣家把省下的錢投回平台並讓利顧客。
items.quote: whenever we've dropped fees to test things out
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 賣家銷售中有 50% 透過 WFS。
items.quote: 50% of our sales came through Walmart Fulfillment Services
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 海外延伸目前聚焦墨西哥、加拿大與智利。
items.quote: Mexico and Canada and then Chile
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 管理層對賣家表示願被問責並兌現成長目標。
items.quote: hold us accountable and we'll deliver those goals
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 對三到五年後的描述：自營與第三方的界線將淡化。
items.quote: the boundaries between 1P and 3P will start eroding
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

items.claim: 管理層預期此模式對賣家、沃爾瑪與顧客都更有獲利性。
items.quote: We see it being a much more profitable business
items.speaker: Manish Joneja (SVP, Global Head of Marketplace and Fulfillment Services)

qa_flags.question: Marketplace 成長 52% 對整體一般商品同店可比的影響有多大？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給 Marketplace 對一般商品同店可比的貢獻數字，改談門市已成履約節點、需要補充性指標與電商 43% 成長。
